title: HOW TO PLAY ONE TO WIN

sections.text:
PURCHASE YOUR TICKET

To purchase a One To Win ticket, go to a vending machine or any counter where Lottery is sold to ask the clerk for a ticket.

How to Choose Your Numbers:

There are two ways to choose your numbers.

To let the computer randomly select a number for you, choose a Quick Pick on the vending machine or tell the cashier you want a Quick Pick at the time of your purchase.
To choose your own number, select a number on the vending machine or tell the cashier which number you would like to select. There are no play slips for Quick Draw games.

Select a number from one to fifteen (1 -15). You can play up to fifteen times on a single ticket. You can also choose the “Bet All” option to play all fifteen numbers for the drawing.

Then select your wager - $1, $2, $5, $10 or $20 per play.

A wager of $1 gives you a chance to win up to $250 and a $20 wager gives you a chance to win up to $5,000!

You can choose to play for one drawing up to fifteen consecutive drawings.

Then, your ticket will print with your numbers on it.

 

INCREASE YOUR PRIZES BY INCREASING YOUR WAGER

When you play One To Win you can choose to wager $1, $2, $5, $10 or $20 per play. Your wager acts as a multiplier if you win a prize in the drawing. So, for example, if you wager $20 per play, the prize you win will be 20 times the prize selected in the drawing.

 

HOW TO WIN

At the beginning of each hourly drawing, a prize from $5 to $250 will randomly be selected. Then, a single winning number from 1 – 15 will be selected.***

You win by matching your number to the winning number and your prize will be multiplied by your wager.

HOW TO CHECK WINNING NUMBERS

You can watch the hourly drawing on the Players Club app or online at ArizonaLottery.com.

You can also check your tickets by scanning them on the Players Club app or a ticket checker at an Arizona Lottery retailer, or by calling the Winning Numbers Hotline:

Phoenix: 480.829.7425
Tucson: 520.325.9141
All Other Areas: 800.499.3798

 

ABOUT WINNING
HOW TO CLAIM YOUR WINNINGS

All Arizona Lottery retailers will redeem prizes up to $100, and may redeem prizes up to $599. See full details about How to Claim Prizes.

 

ONE TO WIN FAQS
WHAT ARE THE ODDS OF WINNING ONE TO WIN?

Overall odds of winning a prize are 1 in 15.

WHEN ARE ONE TO WIN DRAWINGS HELD?

Drawings are held daily every 60 minutes. The first draw of the day is at 4:45 AM Arizona time and the last draw is at 11:45 PM Arizona time.**

HOW OFTEN CAN I PLAY MY NUMBERS?

You can play your numbers for up to 15 consecutive drawing dates on the same ticket. Just tell the cashier at the time of your purchase or select the Multi-Draw box on the vending machine

HOW LONG DO I HAVE TO CLAIM A ONE TO WIN PRIZE?

You have 180 days from the date of the drawing to claim a prize. Once a ticket has expired, it cannot be redeemed even if it is a winner.

WHAT HAPPENS IF MULTIPLE PEOPLE WIN THE MAXIMUM PRIZE?

The players will share the jackpot in equal amounts.*

WHERE DO I FIND THE DRAW ID?

Draw IDs appear on each Quick Draw ticket purchased in the bottom right-hand corner. If you purchased a ticket for more than one drawing, a range of Draw IDs will be included on the ticket. For Example: DRAW ID 10001 or, DRAW ID 10001 THRU DRAW ID 10015

 

DISCLAIMERS

*Liability limit: Prizes would be pari-mutuel when the total prize amount won for a $250 prize draw is above $200,000. The total prize shall be split into equal shares, one share for each winning $1.00 played, rounded down to the nearest dollar. The prize amount per winner is the prize amount per share times the bet amount

**One To Win can be played from 4:00 AM to 11:59 PM Arizona time, seven days a week with the first draw time at 4:45 AM Arizona time. Players have until 11:59 PM Arizona time on each day to purchase One to Win tickets. The last drawing for One To Win will be each day at 11:45 PM Arizona time.

***Lottery numbers broadcasted on television or radio, published on the Arizona State Lottery website, or published and/or communicated by other means does not constitute an official representation of the actual winning lottery numbers. The Arizona State Lottery official audited records of numbers drawn will determine the winning numbers for any draw. A draw game prize must be claimed within 180 days of a drawing.

All sales are final. Drawing game tickets cannot be voided.
